personality_one_liner: A dark, durable, tactical command center for mobile repair technicians, built for fast scanning and operational clarity in workshop environments.

spacing.rule: Dense but clear. Tighter margins between related data points, clear separation between distinct cards. Buttons must remain large (44pt+).

do's: Keep surfaces flat and solid to maximize readability in low light and workshop environments.
dont's: No blur, no glassmorphism. It interferes with the raw utility feel.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Universal search, category browsing, and utility access point.

states.loading: Skeleton lists matching the nested category height
states.empty: No categories found (Should not happen normally)
states.error: Failed to load catalog, retry button.

screens.layout: 1. Header: Brand wordmark (left), EN/HI Language Toggle (right). 2. Full-width action row strictly below header (Voltage Calculator & Export to Excel buttons side-by-side, 44pt height). 3. Sticky Universal Search Bar below action row. If search is active, show absolute-positioned 'Search Results' live panel over the content. 4. Content: Scrollable list of 9 core categories. Tap a category to expand inline into Brand Groups (Redmi, Vivo, etc.). Tap a Brand to expand compatibility lists.

screens.name: CompatibilityGroup
screens.purpose: Showcase exact models that share a spare part with verified status.
screens.layout: Card layout inside expanded brand. Each card has: 1. Top row: Stat pills (e.g., '16 verified', '417 groups'). 2. Body: Wrapped, non-broken text string of compatible models (Model A = Model B = Model C). 3. Right side: Verified stamp (rotated dashed border, #2bd9ae) or Unconfirmed tag. 4. Bottom action row: 'Confirm' button with incrementing count, 'Suggest Correction' button, and source/technician name.

screens.name: AdminUnlock
screens.purpose: Passcode gate to access data entry.
screens.layout: Simple modal or screen. Oversized number pad, solid surface background. Centered input dots.

screens.name: AddData
screens.purpose: Admin form to insert new compatibility mappings.

states.error: Failed to add mapping, show banner.

screens.layout: Standard form. Labels above inputs. Noto Sans body. Submit CTA sticky at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: SuggestCorrection
screens.purpose: Small bottom-sheet form for technicians to flag incorrect data.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet. Text area for correction details. Submit button. Dismiss by swiping down.

macro_parts_background.alt: Mobile phone spare parts macro dark

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Do not use glassmorphism or blur as it contradicts the requested raw workshop utility feel.
Use Oswald (Condensed) for headings and Noto Sans for all body and UI text, as Noto Sans has excellent Devanagari support for the Hindi toggle requirement.
Implement the Verified badge as a rotated stamp with a dashed border, using the success color #2bd9ae as requested.
The action buttons (Voltage Divider Calculator, Export to Excel) MUST sit in their own full-width row right below the header, NEVER squeezed next to text.
Compatibility lists ('Model A = Model B...') must wrap naturally at word boundaries and never break halfway through a model name. Use flex-wrap or text-wrapping appropriately.
Use Phosphor icons with solid, readable strokes. The design should prioritize glanceability and touch accuracy over decoration.

For brand logos that failed to fetch via image selector (Redmi, Vivo, Realme), gracefully fallback to Text-based initial avatars inside a brandTertiary square, but leave the code modular enough to insert real PNGs later.
Build the Universal Search as a sticky component with an absolute-positioned dropdown/panel for live results to prevent layout shifting of the main categories.
